i.norm: Verifies that mergeCentralDirectoryData returns an empty byte array when the input contains only an UnparseableExtraFieldData with no data. UnparseableExtraFieldData is treated as the "last unparseable holder" and its central directory data is appended raw (without a 4-byte header prefix). Since no data has been parsed into it, getCentralDirectoryData() returns an empty/null result, producing a zero-length output array.
Arrange: create an unparseable extra field with no data loaded
Act: merge central directory data — unparseable field contributes no bytes
Assert: result is empty because the unparseable field holds no central directory data
